items.title: Surface solar radiation and day-to-day temperature variability in China during 1961–2022: evidence from the dimming–brightening transition
items.title_en: Surface solar radiation and day-to-day temperature variability in China during 1961–2022: evidence from the dimming–brightening transition
items.title_zh: 1961–2022年期间中国地表太阳辐射与日间气温变异性：来自“变暗—变亮”过渡期的证据
items.summary_en: Climate change affects natural and human systems not only through changes in mean temperature but also through rapid temperature fluctuations between consecutive days. Using homogenized daily mean and maximum temperature observations and reconstructed surface solar radiation at 1759 matched stations in China during 1961–2022, we evaluated the seasonal cycles, probability distributions, and long-term trends of day-to-day temperature variability (DTD and DTDMAX). The regression adjustment was applied to extract the fitted component of temperature anomalies that is statistically correlated with simultaneous radiation anomalies. The results show that, both of DTD and DTDMAX exhibited higher values in winter and spring than in summer and autumn, and the radiation-associated differences were stronger for DTDMAX. The distributions shifted leftward after regression adjusted for most river basins, with substantially larger distributional contrasts for DTDMAX than for DTD. The annual DTD and DTDMAX in most regions showed an interdecadal transition, which is highly consistent with ‘global dimming and brightening’. The increasing trends in DTD and DTDMAX during 1991–2022 were weaker in the regression adjusted series than in the original series, indicating that part of their long-term increase was statistically associated with contemporaneous solar radiation. The slope changed from 0.015 to −0.004 °C/10a for DTD, and from 0.049 to 0.001 °C/10a for DTDMAX in the Yangtze River Basin. After removing linear trends and controlling for annual precipitation, positive correlations with day-to-day radiation variability occurred in 81.28% of grid cells for DTD and 89.60% for DTDMAX. The results show that short-term thermal variability is associated with surface radiation variability, particularly for daily maximum temperature. These findings advance our understanding of short-term temperature variability across China, with meaningful implications for the climate related impacts and environmental risk under a warming climate.
items.summary_zh: 气候变化不仅通过平均气温的变化，还通过连续几天之间的快速气温波动，对自然和人类系统产生影响。 利用1961–2022年间中国1759个匹配观测站经同化处理的日均温和日最高温观测数据，以及重建的地表太阳辐射数据，我们评估了日间温度变异性（DTD和DTDMAX）的季节周期、概率分布和长期趋势。 通过回归调整，提取了与同期辐射异常在统计上相关联的温度异常拟合分量。结果表明，无论是DTD还是DTDMAX，其冬季和春季的数值均高于夏季和秋季，且DTDMAX与辐射相关的差异更为显著。 在对大多数流域进行回归调整后，其分布均向左偏移，其中 DTDMAX 的分布对比远大于 DTD。大多数地区的年 DTD 和 DTDMAX 均呈现出跨十年尺度转变，这与“全球变暗与变亮”现象高度一致。 在1991–2022年期间，经回归调整后的DTD和DTDMAX上升趋势较原始数据系列更为微弱，这表明其长期上升趋势的一部分在统计上与同期太阳辐射相关。 在长江流域，DTD的斜率从0.015变为−0.004 °C/10a，DTDMAX的斜率从0.049变为0.001 °C/10a。 在剔除线性趋势并控制年降水量后，81.28%的网格单元中 DTD 与日辐射变异性呈正相关，89.60%的网格单元中 DTDMAX 与日辐射变异性呈正相关。 结果表明，短期温度变异性与地表辐射变异性存在关联，尤其是日最高温度。这些发现深化了我们对中国境内短期温度变异性的理解，并对气候相关影响及环境

items.title: Indoor air quality at the climate-health nexus: the case for enforceable standards
items.title_en: Indoor air quality at the climate-health nexus: the case for enforceable standards
items.title_zh: 室内空气质量与气候健康的关系：制定可执行标准的必要性
items.summary_en: The COVID-19 pandemic exposed a longstanding governance gap: most people spend much of their time indoors, yet indoor air quality remains far less regulated than outdoor air. Climate change is now worsening that gap by increasing the frequency and severity of wildfire smoke and heat-driven building closures, both of which degrade air quality in homes, schools, workplaces and other occupied spaces. Poor indoor air quality is therefore no longer only a building-performance issue; it is a climate-health problem with clear implications for infection control, chronic disease, cognitive performance and equity. The case for action is strengthened by growing evidence that the costs of inaction are substantial, while the benefits of better indoor environments are measurable. This perspective piece argues that indoor air quality should be governed through enforceable, performance-based standards with statutory force, beginning in settings where exposure is unavoidable and vulnerability is high. Australia is used as an illustrative case to show how monitoring, institutional responsibility and phased implementation could be built into a practical regulatory pathway.
items.summary_zh: 新冠疫情暴露了一个长期存在的治理缺口：尽管大多数人大部分时间都在室内度过，但室内空气质量的监管却远不如室外空气严格。 气候变化正通过增加野火烟雾的频率和严重程度，以及因高温导致的建筑物关闭，进一步加剧这一差距——这两者都会导致家庭、学校、工作场所及其他有人活动的空间内的空气质量恶化。 因此，室内空气质量差已不再仅仅是建筑性能问题；它已成为一个涉及气候与健康的问题，对感染控制、慢性病、认知能力及公平性均有明确影响。越来越多的证据表明，不作为的代价巨大，而改善室内环境带来的益处则可量化，这进一步强化了采取行动的必要性。 本文认为，应通过具有法定效力、可强制执行且基于性能的标准来规范室内空气质量，并优先从暴露不可避免且脆弱性较高的场所着手。本文以澳大利亚为例，说明如何将监测、机构责任和分阶段实施纳入切实可行的监管路径。

items.title: Can Class 3 e-bikes help meet California’s VMT and climate goals? A mobility-substitution screening
items.title_en: Can Class 3 e-bikes help meet California’s VMT and climate goals? A mobility-substitution screening
items.title_zh: 3类电动自行车能否助力实现加利福尼亚州的车辆行驶里程（VMT）和气候目标？一项出行方式替代性评估
items.summary_en: Transportation is California’s largest source of greenhouse gas emissions, and vehicle electrification alone does not reduce vehicle-miles traveled (VMT). This paper asks whether Class 3 e-bikes—pedal-assisted to 28 mph—could replace some of the intermediate-distance commutes that conventional bicycles rarely serve. Using 2024 LOCUS mobility data for Los Angeles County, we define an addressable commute band as weekday peak-period Motorized travel of 5–15 miles one way. This market contains 11.98 million passenger-miles per weekday, while conventional bicycles account for only about 0.3% of passenger-miles under the same filters. European speed-pedelec evidence shows that these distances are within routine operating range. Because LOCUS includes e-bikes within Motorized travel, the scenarios explicitly vary both the automobile share of that category and the share of Class 3 travel that actually replaces car travel. In the upper-bound full-substitution case, a 10% shift removes 283 million vehicle-miles and 101.6 ktCO2e per year. That is 5.6 times LA Metro’s published bikeway VMT benefit, mainly because the trips considered here are longer. Yet the same scenario removes only about 0.43% of modeled county passenger VMT, and the 30% stress test about 1.3%. Class 3 e-bikes are therefore a potentially important intermediate-distance option, but only one part of the much larger mobility transition required in California.
items.summary_zh: 交通运输是加利福尼亚州最大的温室气体排放源，而仅靠车辆电气化并不能减少车辆行驶里程（VMT）。本文探讨了第3类电动自行车——即最高时速可达28英里且配备踏板辅助功能的车型——能否替代部分传统自行车鲜少覆盖的中距离通勤需求。 基于2024年洛杉矶县LOCUS出行数据，我们将目标通勤区间定义为工作日高峰时段单程5–15英里的机动车出行。 该市场每周工作日的人次英里总量达1198万，而在采用相同筛选条件的情况下，传统自行车仅占其中约0.3%。 欧洲高速电动助力自行车（speed-pedelec）的实证数据表明，这些距离处于其常规行驶范围之内。由于LOCUS将电动自行车纳入“机动化出行”范畴，因此各种情景分析会明确调整该类别中汽车的占比，以及实际替代汽车出行的第3类出行（Class 3）的占比。 在完全替代的上限情景下，10%的出行模式转换每年可减少2.83亿车辆英里和101.6千吨二氧化碳当量。这一减排量是洛杉矶大都会区（LA Metro）公布的自行车道车辆英里（VMT）减排效益的5.6倍，主要原因在于此处考虑的出行距离更长。 然而，同一情景仅减少了模型中该县客运车辆行驶里程（VMT）的约0.43%，而30%的压力测试情景也仅减少了约1.3%。因此，第三类电动自行车虽是潜在的重要中距离出行选择，但仅是加利福尼亚州所需更大规模出行转型中的一部分。

items.title: Seasonality defines groundwater recharge thresholds across Australia
items.title_en: Seasonality defines groundwater recharge thresholds across Australia
items.title_zh: 季节性因素决定了澳大利亚各地地下水补给的阈值
items.summary_en: Reliable prediction of groundwater recharge from rainfall is crucial to water management but is scientifically challenging. Previous studies have demonstrated that caves, mines, and tunnels provide useful ‘windows’ for observing rainfall recharge timing and thresholds (i.e. amount of rainfall in a given time period causing a change in dripping from the void ceiling). Using drip loggers at sites across the Australian continent, we find that annual median rainfall recharge thresholds (RRTs) are statistically similar across 16 sites. However, thresholds vary by season. In climates dominated by winter rainfall, recharge is highly unlikely to occur during summer and autumn, even for high volume rain events. Similarly, during drought years winter rainfall may not be sufficient to cause recharge, even for events where RRTs are met. Conversely, montane and summer-wet sites showed a more reliable recharge response to rain events above the RRT. This enhanced understanding of recharge dynamics should be considered in modeling aquifer dynamics and planning sustainable groundwater use.
items.summary_zh: 可靠地预测降雨对地下水的补给对水资源管理至关重要，但在科学上却颇具挑战性。先前研究表明，洞穴、矿井和隧道为观察降雨补给的时间点和阈值（即在给定时间段内导致空洞顶部滴水量发生变化的降雨量）提供了有用的“观察窗口”。 我们利用分布于澳大利亚大陆各地的滴水记录仪发现，16个观测点的年降雨补给阈值（RRT）在统计上具有相似性。然而，这些阈值会随季节而变化。在以冬季降雨为主的气候条件下，即使出现强降雨事件，夏季和秋季也很难发生地下水补给。 同样，在干旱年份，即使降雨量达到RRT，冬季降雨也可能不足以引发补给。相反，山区和夏季多雨的站点对超过RRT的降雨事件表现出更可靠的补给响应。在建模含水层动态及规划可持续地下水利用时，应将对补给动态的这一深入理解纳入考量。

items.title: Thousands of Handwritten Records Reveal Scale of Warming in the Congo
items.title_en: Thousands of Handwritten Records Reveal Scale of Warming in the Congo
items.title_zh: 数千份手写记录揭示了刚果地区变暖的程度
items.summary_en: The Congo Basin is one of the few places on Earth where the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change has failed to track the long-term shift in extreme heat and rainfall. The reason is a lack of readily available data. To fill this gap, scientists have digitized thousands of handwritten weather records, which reveal the impact of warming in the region. Read more on E360 →

items.title: Scientists uncover the 2.3-billion-year-old secret that helped keep Earth habitable
items.title_en: Scientists uncover the 2.3-billion-year-old secret that helped keep Earth habitable
items.title_zh: 科学家揭开了这个有助于维持地球宜居性的、距今23亿年的秘密
items.summary_en: Scientists may have solved a 2.3-billion-year-old mystery about how Earth maintained enough oxygen to support life. Ancient rocks reveal that phosphorus recycling in the oceans created a self-sustaining cycle that helped keep oxygen levels high, even as the planet underwent dramatic environmental changes. The discovery challenges assumptions about Earth's early atmosphere and raises new questions about why complex life took so long to emerge.
items.summary_zh: 科学家们可能已经解开了关于地球如何维持足够氧气以支持生命这一存在了23亿年的谜团。 古代岩石揭示，海洋中的磷循环形成了一个自我维持的循环系统，即使在地球经历剧烈环境变化的时期，该系统也帮助维持了较高的氧气含量。这一发现挑战了关于地球早期大气层的假设，并引发了新的疑问：为什么复杂生命出现得如此之晚？
